items.q: Is StudentsUni actually free to use?
items.a: Yes. Browsing universities, comparing programmes, and getting consultation from our counsellors is free for students. We work with universities and don't charge students for guidance.

items.q: How accurate and up to date is your fee and requirement data?
items.a: We compile programme data from official university sources and recognised education portals, cross-checking where possible. Fees and requirements change yearly, so we always recommend confirming final figures directly with the university before you apply.

items.q: Do you help with the actual application, not just comparisons?
items.a: Yes. Beyond browsing, our counsellors help with shortlisting, document preparation, and application submission. Book a free consultation and we'll walk you through it.

items.q: Do you only cover public universities, or private ones too?
items.a: Both. Our directory includes public universities, private universities, and private university colleges across Malaysia, so you can compare across all of them in one place.

hero.label: Who we are
hero.subtitle: We help students find and enroll in the right university in Malaysia — free, transparent, and student-first.

story.label: Our story
story.title: A single place for every option.
story.p1: StudentsUni was created to simplify the university search and application process for students in Malaysia. We noticed that finding the right program — with accurate fees, requirements, and accreditation info — was unnecessarily difficult.
story.p2: Our platform aggregates data from official university sources and recognized education portals, giving students a single place to compare options and make informed decisions.
story.p3: Beyond the website, we offer free consultation services to guide students through the application and enrollment process.

header.title: Our Services
header.subtitle: End-to-end support for your education journey in Malaysia. All services are free for students.

items.title: Free Consultation
items.description: Sit down with our education counselors to discuss your options. We help you understand what's available based on your qualifications, budget, and career goals.

items.title: University Selection
items.description: We help you shortlist universities and programs that match your profile. We consider factors like entry requirements, fees, location, and career outcomes.

items.title: Application Assistance
items.description: From filling out forms to preparing your documents, we guide you through the entire application process. We make sure nothing is missed.

items.title: Visa Guidance
items.description: Navigating visa requirements can be confusing. We provide up-to-date guidance on student visa applications for international students.

items.title: Pre-Departure Briefing
items.description: Before you leave, we brief you on what to expect — accommodation, banking, transport, and settling into student life in Malaysia.

items.title: Post-Arrival Support
items.description: We don't disappear after you land. Reach out to us for help with any issues you face during your first weeks in Malaysia.
